summary: fix(settings): center the loading spinner on v2 pair approve_signin
description:
Because:

- In pairing v2 on desktop, the spinner on /pair/authority/approve_signin
  showed in the page corner, not in the center.

This commit:

- Passes fullScreen to LoadingSpinner in the ApproveSignIn container.
- Adds a container test for the full-screen spinner layout.

Closes FXA-14772
